sentences.zh: 我不喜欢他们把德怀特的整个梦想设定成真，只是为了能像这样……

sentences.en: They're being jerks, but I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 他们表现得像个混蛋，但我很抱歉。

sentences.en: I think in particular, Jim, and it was hard for me as Pam, who has a soft spot for Dwight, to find a way to do this thing for her husband that was resulting in her friend…
sentences.zh: 我觉得尤其是吉姆，作为对德怀特心存软肋的帕姆，我很难找到一种方式去为丈夫做这件事，结果却导致我的朋友……

sentences.en: And I just, I didn't like the snickering.
sentences.zh: 我就是不喜欢那种窃笑。

sentences.en: I didn't like what I also sort of saw as kind of this like smug, too cool for school kind of vibe.
sentences.zh: 我也不喜欢我所看到的某种自鸣得意、自以为是的那种氛围。
那是从吉姆身上散发出来的。

sentences.en: It was, I didn't like it.
I didn't find Jim likable in this storyline.
sentences.zh: 我觉得吉姆在这个故事线里一点也不讨喜。

sentences.en: Also, just like, why haven't you said anything to Daryl?
sentences.zh: 还有，为什么你还没跟达里尔说呢？
吉姆太以自我为中心了。

sentences.en: He's having that moment where he has this new thing that is really distracting him and occupying all of his space and also maybe making him lose sight on the people that matter around him.
sentences.zh: 他正处于这样一个阶段，有一件新事物让他分心，占据了他所有的空间，也可能让他忽略了身边重要的人。

sentences.en: He's just having his little selfish chapter here.
sentences.zh: 他现在正处于一个自私的小阶段。

sentences.en: And we all have them in our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们生活中都会有这样的阶段。

sentences.en: And then we come out of the fog and we're like, oh, I was kind of a turd back then.
sentences.zh: 然后当我们走出迷雾时，会想，哦，我当时真是个混蛋。

sentences.en: And that's okay because he'll come out of the fog.
sentences.zh: 没关系，因为他会走出迷雾的。

sentences.en: You got to come out of the fog.
Well, Jim is going to realize now, oh, my gosh, I have to go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，吉姆现在意识到，天哪，我得走了。

sentences.en: I have to go to Philly.
And both Pam and Dwight are taken aback.
sentences.zh: 帕姆和德怀特都大吃一惊。

sentences.en: They're like, oh, my gosh, already?
sentences.zh: 他们心想，天哪，这么快吗？

sentences.en: They're both bummed out in their own different ways.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都以各自不同的方式感到沮丧。

sentences.en: But before he leaves, Belschnickel needs to judge if he was impish or admirable.
sentences.zh: 但在他离开之前，贝尔施尼克尔需要评判他到底是淘气还是令人钦佩。

sentences.en: We got a fan question from Ty B in Calgary, Alberta.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了来自艾伯塔省卡尔加里泰·B的一位粉丝提问。

sentences.en: When Dwight was whacking Jim with the stick, is he actually hitting him?
sentences.zh: 当德怀特用棍子打吉姆时，他是真的打到了他吗？

sentences.en: I remember the pieces of the stick breaking off as Rain whacked him with that.
sentences.zh: 我记得雷恩用那根棍子打他时，棍子碎片都飞出来了。

sentences.en: When I watched the scene, I was like, oh, yeah, remember how hard he was hitting him?
sentences.zh: 当我看到那一幕时，我心想，哦，对，还记得他打得有多用力吗？

sentences.en: I will tell you, there's a moment, and you can see, it's truly honest, where John is like,
sentences.zh: 我告诉你们，有一个瞬间，你们能看出来，那是真实的反应，当时约翰的表情是，

sentences.en: Well, we asked Rain if he remembered this scene, and here is what he said.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们问了雷恩是否记得这一幕，他是这么说的。

sentences.en: You know, the number one thing that I remember is, like, I was infamous for hurting people on the set.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我记得最清楚的一件事就是，我因为在片场伤人而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: At one point, I had thrown a mini barbell up in the air, and it hit, right, Robinson in the head and gave him a bump the size of a golf ball.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我把一个迷你杠铃扔向空中，结果砸中了罗宾逊的头，起了一个高尔夫球那么大的包。

sentences.en: You know, I'd thrown a snowball in John's face.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我还往约翰脸上扔过雪球。

sentences.en: I'd knocked sand into Leslie's eyes.
sentences.zh: 我还把沙子弄进了莱斯利的眼睛里。

sentences.en: Like, everyone had some way, shape, or form had been hurt by Rain playing Dwight in some way, shape, or form.
sentences.zh: 总之，每个人都以某种形式被饰演德怀特的雷恩伤害过。

sentences.en: So, I knew, like, oh, jeez, I've got to, like, literally whip people with a straw baton.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当时想，天哪，我得真的用草编的指挥棒去抽人。

sentences.en: Someone's going to get their eye gouged out.
sentences.zh: 肯定会有人眼睛被戳瞎的。

sentences.en: So, probably I hit John too many times and too hard, and I think a couple of times I tried to hit him in the groinal area,
sentences.zh: 所以，我可能打约翰打得太多、太用力了，而且我觉得有几次我是故意想打他的腹股沟区域，

sentences.en: just on purpose, just because it was so much fun.
sentences.zh: 就是故意的，纯粹是因为太好玩了。

sentences.en: I would like to just get a little reaction out of him.
sentences.zh: 我就是想看看他的反应。

sentences.en: So, I was very wary and careful around that.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那方面我非常谨慎小心。

sentences.en: Well, Rain, I remember all those same things.
sentences.zh: 好吧，雷恩，我记得所有这些事。

sentences.en: I like how you said, Rain, that you were very careful around that area, but you still tried to hit it.
sentences.zh: 雷恩，我喜欢你刚才说的，你说你在那个区域非常小心，但你还是试着去打它。

sentences.en: Well, lady, before we move on, my neighbor is such a big fan of the show and wanted to make a message for us.
sentences.zh: 好吧，女士，在我们继续之前，我的邻居是这部剧的超级粉丝，他想给我们留个言。

sentences.en: He's such a huge fan, and we'll hear.
sentences.zh: 他是超级粉丝，我们来听听。
真是个了不起的里程碑。

sentences.en: Well, cool beans, and congratulations, girls.
sentences.zh: 哇，太棒了，恭喜你们，姑娘们。

sentences.en: I did not know what to expect when you set that up.
sentences.zh: 你们安排那个的时候，我真不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: Your face, you were like, what?
sentences.zh: 看你的表情，你当时心想，什么？

sentences.en: Because I know I saw you doing that thing in your brain of like, who, what, who, what neighbor?
sentences.zh: 因为我知道你当时脑子里肯定在想：谁？什么？哪位邻居？

sentences.en: I thought it was going to be like a kid or somebody who lives in your neighborhood, and it was the biggest kid of all, Creed.
sentences.zh: 我以为会是个孩子或者住在你附近的某个人，结果竟然是最大的“孩子”，克里德。

sentences.en: Creed, who lives at the end of my street.
sentences.zh: 克里德，他就住在我那条街的尽头。

sentences.en: He's been so supportive of the podcast, and he wanted to wish us happy 200th.
sentences.zh: 他一直很支持我们的播客，他想祝贺我们迎来第200集。

sentences.en: Well, now Pam is going to walk Jim to his cab.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在帕姆要送吉姆去坐出租车了。

sentences.en: I can't believe it's actually happening.
sentences.zh: 我真不敢相信这一切真的要发生了。

sentences.en: And Jim says, thanks for putting together such a great last Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说，谢谢你筹办了这么棒的最后一次圣诞派对。

sentences.en: I felt that on two levels.
sentences.zh: 我从两个层面感受到了这一点。

sentences.en: I was like, this is it.
This is the last Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 这是最后一次圣诞派对。

sentences.en: Yeah, he also makes a joke, and he's like, well, I guess this is goodbye.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他还开了个玩笑，他说，好吧，我想这就是再见了。

sentences.en: You know, I'll never see you again or something like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我再也见不到你了之类的。

sentences.en: I can't remember the exact joke.
sentences.zh: 我不记得具体的笑话是什么了。

sentences.en: And Pam's like, come on, I'm trying to be serious here.
sentences.zh: 帕姆说，拜托，我正想认真点呢。

sentences.en: And I felt like this was another moment that we were trying to play to show how Jim's head is a little bit in the clouds.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是我们试图表现吉姆有点心不在焉的另一个时刻。

sentences.en: He's enamored with the new job.
He's having that selfish time, and he's not seeing Pam.
sentences.zh: 他正处于那种自私的阶段，没顾及到帕姆。

sentences.en: He's not registering last Christmas party and, like, the look on her face.
sentences.zh: 他没意识到这是最后一次圣诞派对，也没注意到帕姆脸上的表情。

sentences.en: He's not registering, like, the separation of their family so that this job can happen.
sentences.zh: 他没意识到，为了这份工作，他们的家庭正在经历分离。

sentences.en: Yes, and also, I don't know if you noticed, but Pam says, I love you, as he's getting into the cab.
sentences.zh: 没错，还有，不知道你有没有注意到，帕姆在吉姆上车时说了“我爱你”。

sentences.en: And he's like, oh, yeah, I love you, too.
sentences.zh: 而他却说，噢，是啊，我也爱你。

sentences.en: It's like everything is a real afterthought for Jim here.
sentences.zh: 对吉姆来说，这里的一切都像是事后才想起来的。

sentences.en: And it's meant to be kind of to show, like, oh, wow, they are in different spaces right now.
sentences.zh: 这旨在表现出，噢，哇，他们现在处于不同的频道上。

sentences.en: Well, Pam is going to very sadly walk back into the office, and Dwight has been watching all of this from the window.
sentences.zh: 帕姆非常难过地走回办公室，而德怀特一直在窗边看着这一切。

sentences.en: Well, as Pam's going up to the office, Dwight is on his way out.
sentences.zh: 帕姆走回办公室时，德怀特正要离开。

sentences.en: He's taken all of his decorations down.
sentences.zh: 他已经拆掉了所有的装饰。

sentences.en: You bell on Christmas, Christmas bells on you.
sentences.zh: 圣诞铃铛，圣诞铃铛都在你身上。

sentences.en: But the Christmas party is going to continue because Phyllis finds some old decorations in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 但圣诞派对还要继续，因为菲利斯在仓库里找到了一些旧装饰。

sentences.en: Oscar ran to the store for food and drinks.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡跑去商店买了食物和饮料。

sentences.en: I guess they needed me after all.
sentences.zh: 我想他们终究还是需要我的。

sentences.en: And, Lady, I have to share with you, I have a little call sheet tidbit here.
sentences.zh: 还有，Lady，我得跟你分享一下，我这儿有个关于通告单的小趣闻。

sentences.en: I think I know what this call sheet tidbit is.
sentences.zh: 我想我知道这个通告单趣闻是什么了。

sentences.en: The Dunder Mifflin crew is decorating for Christmas, but in real life on our set, it was Halloween.
sentences.zh: 邓德·米夫林的员工们在布置圣诞装饰，但在现实生活中，我们片场当时正值万圣节。

sentences.en: This used to happen all the time.
When we would shoot our Christmas episode, it would be Halloween week in real life.
sentences.zh: 当我们拍摄圣诞特辑时，现实中往往正好是万圣节那一周。

sentences.en: This has happened more than once.
sentences.zh: 这种情况不止发生过一次。

sentences.en: And boy, did our cast and crew love Halloween.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我们的演职人员可太爱万圣节了。

sentences.en: I mean, I shared in last week's episode, there was a countdown on the call sheets to Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我在上周的节目里分享过，通告单上甚至还有万圣节倒计时。

sentences.en: Well, Steve Burgess sent me the call sheet for October 31St.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·伯吉斯给我发了10月31号的通告单。

sentences.en: Someone was having a lot of fun with this call sheet, lady.
sentences.zh: 有人在做这份通告单时玩得很开心，Lady。

sentences.en: First of all, normally on a call sheet, it tells you the crew call and what time everyone's called to set.
sentences.zh: 首先，通常通告单上会写明剧组集合时间和每个人的片场报到时间。

sentences.en: On this one, it says the bewitching hour and the spooky call.
sentences.zh: 但在这一份上，写的是“巫术时刻”和“惊悚报到”。

sentences.en: And then, normally we have a message if there's going to be an on-set photographer, and it will say, NBC still photographer on set today.
sentences.zh: 通常如果有现场摄影师，通告单上会写“NBC剧照摄影师今日在场”。

sentences.en: But on this call sheet announcement, it said the NBC still coroner will be on set today.
sentences.zh: 但在这份通告单的公告里，写的是“NBC验尸官今日在场”。

sentences.en: There's also announcement that the Halloween costume contest will be at lunch.
sentences.zh: 上面还宣布午餐时间会举办万圣节变装比赛。

sentences.en: And then, if you go to the back of the call sheet, for all of the different crew categories, they were changed to different names.
sentences.zh: 如果你翻到通告单背面，所有不同的剧组部门名称都被改成了别的名字。

sentences.en: For example, instead of saying hair and makeup with everyone's call times, it says morticians.
sentences.zh: 比如，原本写着发型和化妆以及每个人的报到时间，现在改成了“殡葬师”。

sentences.en: There's the headhunters, there's the groundskeepers, there's the bloody heart department, the grave robbers, the flamethrowers, the office of the recently deceased.
sentences.zh: 还有“猎头者”、“守墓人”、“血腥心脏部”、“盗墓贼”、“喷火器”，以及“新近逝者办公室”。

sentences.en: And in the transportation department, they were labeled, instead of transportation, hearses.
sentences.zh: 交通部门也被改了名，不再叫交通部，而是叫“灵车部”。

sentences.en: I mean, someone was just having a really good time with all of this, and I'm going to share it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有人在做这些的时候真的玩得很开心，我一定要分享出来。

sentences.en: Well, I remember this Halloween, because my son was a year old, and we were going to dress him up as a Wimbledon tennis player.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个万圣节，因为我儿子当时一岁，我们打算把他打扮成温布尔登网球选手。

sentences.en: We had gone to Wimbledon when I was pregnant, and we had gotten a teeny baby-sized Wimbledon shirt.
sentences.zh: 我怀孕的时候去过温布尔登，我们买了一件婴儿尺寸的温布尔登小球衣。

sentences.en: And we were like, oh, this is such a good costume, because he can wear the shirt, he can wear the little white shorts.
sentences.zh: 我们当时想，噢，这装扮太棒了，因为他可以穿上那件球衣，再穿上白色小短裤。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, I want to get him, like, a little tennis racket, like a little toy tennis racket.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，噢，我想给他弄个小网球拍，那种玩具小球拍。

sentences.en: Well, I couldn't find any that were, like, the right size for him.
sentences.zh: 但我找不到尺寸合适的。
确实，那些球拍都太大了。

sentences.en: So I was just chatting with Phil Shea, the amazing Phil Shea, and I said, Phil, what would you do if you had to get, like, a tiny tennis racket for, like, a one-year-old?
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就和菲尔·谢——那位了不起的菲尔·谢——聊天，我说，菲尔，如果你得给一岁大的孩子弄个小网球拍，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: Like, where would you get that?
Where can you point me in the right direction?
And he said, Jenna, I got it.
Like, you don't need anything more to do.
sentences.zh: 你已经够忙的了，不需要再操心这个。

sentences.en: He was like, no, I'll get it.
This was like a few weeks before Halloween.
sentences.zh: 那大概是万圣节前几周的事。

sentences.en: For Halloween, Angela, Phil Shea presented me with a tiny tennis racket lady.
sentences.zh: 万圣节的时候，安吉拉，菲尔·谢送给我一个拿着迷你网球拍的小人儿。

sentences.en: He had someone make your son a real teeny tiny real racket with strings and everything.
sentences.zh: 他找人给你儿子做了一个真正的小球拍，有球线，什么都有。

sentences.en: Yes, with a teeny tiny tennis bag.
sentences.zh: 对，还有一个超小的网球包。

sentences.en: I was like, Phil, what is this?
sentences.zh: 我当时就问，菲尔，这是什么？

sentences.en: I was like, what have you done?
sentences.zh: 我当时就问，你都做了些什么？

sentences.en: I mean, this tennis racket made the outfit.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这把网球拍简直是整套造型的点睛之笔。

sentences.en: And you know, guys, we all gathered recently for a celebration of life for Phil.
sentences.zh: 你们知道吗，伙计们，我们最近聚在一起为菲尔举办了一场生命礼赞。

sentences.en: All of our crew came and celebrated him, the crews of other shows he had worked on.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的剧组人员都来了，还有他曾工作过的其他剧组的人，大家一起纪念他。

sentences.en: It was so wonderful to see how many lives Phil touched.
sentences.zh: 看到菲尔影响了这么多人的生活，真是太美好了。

sentences.en: It was so bittersweet, but also so special to see our crew and to spend time with them and to share our memories of Phil.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉苦乐参半，但能见到我们的剧组人员，和他们待在一起，分享关于菲尔的回忆，真的很特别。

sentences.en: And this was a story that I told because it's so very Phil.
sentences.zh: 我讲这个故事是因为它太有菲尔的风格了。

sentences.en: So I remember this, and I have pictures.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得这件事，我还有照片。

sentences.en: I love the pictures from this Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那个万圣节拍的照片。

sentences.en: And also, Steve Burgess shared some of his photos from the Halloween costume conteSt.
sentences.zh: 还有，史蒂夫·伯吉斯分享了一些他在万圣节化妆比赛时拍的照片。

sentences.en: Our crew would often coordinate costumes, and so there was a group this year, I remember, who did Scooby-Doo.
sentences.zh: 我们的剧组人员经常会统一服装，我记得那年有一组人扮成了《史酷比》里的角色。

sentences.en: I have a photo that I love of my daughter and your son on set together.
sentences.zh: 我有一张很喜欢的照片，是我女儿和你儿子在片场的合影。

sentences.en: He's in his tennis outfit, and you would never know this because she's just in a pink shirt and pink leggings, but she was a cupcake,
sentences.zh: 他穿着网球装，你可能看不出来，因为她当时只穿了粉色上衣和粉色打底裤，但她扮的是个纸杯蛋糕，

sentences.en: like a papier-mâché cupcake that you step into.
sentences.zh: 就是那种纸糊的、人可以钻进去的纸杯蛋糕。

sentences.en: But she got tired of wearing it, so she took it off.
sentences.zh: 但她穿累了，就把外壳脱掉了。

sentences.en: She was just the underneath part.
sentences.zh: 她只留下了里面的部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, but they were a cupcake and a tennis player.
sentences.zh: 没错，但他们当时一个是纸杯蛋糕，一个是网球运动员。

sentences.en: This was a really special episode.

sentences.zh: 每个人都带了自己的孩子来。

sentences.en: It was our last Christmas episode and our last Halloween parade all in one.
sentences.zh: 那是我们最后一集圣诞特辑，也是最后一次万圣节游行，合在一起了。

sentences.en: Nellie hears the party starting, but Toby is still sharing with her about his jury experience.
sentences.zh: 奈莉听到了派对开始的声音，但托比还在跟她讲自己的陪审团经历。

sentences.en: There's a great montage in the bullpen of people starting to have a good time.
sentences.zh: 办公区里有一段很棒的蒙太奇，大家开始玩得很开心。

sentences.en: At 16 minutes, 33 seconds, did anyone else catch Brian as Kevin lifting me off the credenza?
sentences.zh: 在16分33秒的时候，还有人注意到布莱恩饰演的凯文把我从餐具柜上抱下来了吗？

sentences.en: I was supposed to be up there hanging decorations, and I legitimately couldn't get down and needed help.
